name: conflux-verifyflow
description: Conflux eSpace deploy & verify preflight — RPC, chainId, ConfluxScan lint

scripts.build:vercel: npm run build -w @verifyflow/core && npm run build -w @verifyflow/web
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=core && npx vercel dev --listen 5180
scripts.preview:web: npm run build:vercel && npm run preview --workspace=web
